sub-flow.name: provider-fak-quote-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: GET /products/{id} on provider A. An unknown id answers 200 with an empty body

http:request.doc:description: Calls provider A and expects a JSON product with title, price and currency

ee:transform.doc:description: Product as a quote, or not found when the body is empty

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import found, notFound from modules::providers output application/java --- if ((attributes.headers.'content-length' default '') == '0' or isEmpty(payload)) notFound else found('FAK', vars.externalId, payload.title, payload.price, payload.currency)

sub-flow.name: provider-esc-quote-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: GET /api/v1/products/{id} on provider B. An unknown id answers 400

try.doc:description: Turns the provider B 400 or 404 (unknown product) into not found

http:request.doc:description: Calls provider B and expects a JSON product with title, price and currency

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import found from modules::providers output application/java --- found('ESC', vars.externalId, payload.title, payload.price, payload.currency)

on-error-continue.doc:description: Provider B answers 400 for an unknown id: not a failure

ee:transform.doc:description: The provider does not know the product

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import notFound from modules::providers output application/java --- notFound

sub-flow.name: provider-bor-quote-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: GetArticleById on provider C. An unknown id answers without GetArticleByIdResult

ee:transform.doc:description: SOAP body GetArticleById with the numeric ArticleId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/xml ns tem http://tempuri.org/ --- { tem#GetArticleById: { tem#ArticleId: vars.externalId as Number } }

wsc:consume.doc:description: Calls the GetArticleById operation of provider C

ee:transform.doc:description: Article as a quote (Name, Price, Currency), or not found without a result

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import found, notFound from modules::providers output application/java ns tem http://tempuri.org/ var result = payload.body.tem#GetArticleByIdResponse.tem#GetArticleByIdResult --- if (result == null) notFound else found('BOR', vars.externalId, result.tem#Name, result.tem#Price, result.tem#Currency)
